aliases: where does a worker look for work
name: How a worker finds its work and how a coordinator reaches it: one served text, a page for every member, served prompts
summary: One served text describes guidance, resume, own review feedback and newer activity before ready work, one unheld task, and guidance/assignment/task comments as contact routes. Served recurring prompts stay short and carry no state. Members and agents read fixed documents through GET /v1/docs and /v1/docs/NAME. The How work is found page includes viewers, fills known values once and preserves placeholder-shaped names literally. Read-specific errors for503, missing404/501,403/401 and transport failure offer safe retry. Concrete names and extracted SSH commands are tested against actual catalogues. Web-agent guidance remains unavailable and setup owner/superuser-only. Blocked and in-progress actions link to their actual brief and authorized history; without a checkpoint activity is unknown and the coordinator asks for history reconciliation and a first checkpoint.
